title: BAI Forms New Athletes Committee to Boost Player Representation
indian_angle: This committee ensures Indian badminton players have a direct voice in the sport's administration and development.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has announced the formation of its new Athletes Committee, aimed at giving players a greater say in decisions affecting their careers and the sport's future in India.

title: Junior National Camp Underway for World Championships in Guwahati
indian_angle: India's top junior talent is currently training at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati, preparing to represent the nation at the upcoming BWF World Junior Championships.
summary: A national coaching camp for the BWF World Junior Championships 2026 is being held at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati, bringing together India's promising young shuttlers for intensive training.

title: Advanced Coaches Course Concludes in Guwahati and Raipur
indian_angle: This course enhances the skills of Indian badminton coaches, directly impacting the quality of training for future national players.
summary: The BAI Level-1 (Advanced) Coaches Course concluded recently, with sessions held at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati and Raipur, focusing on upgrading coaching methodologies across India.

title: Indian Junior Team Camps for Asia U17 & U15 Championships in Guwahati
indian_angle: Young Indian shuttlers are undergoing rigorous training at the NCE Guwahati to prepare for the Badminton Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships, aiming for continental success.
summary: The National Center of Excellence in Guwahati is hosting a coaching camp for the Indian team selected for the upcoming Badminton Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships 2026, focusing on honing their skills for international competition.

title: India Invites Entries for BWF World Championships 2026 Mascot Design
indian_angle: India is hosting the prestigious BWF World Championships in 2026, and this competition engages the public in creating an iconic symbol for the event on home soil.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has launched a mascot design competition for the BWF World Championships 2026, which India will host, inviting creative entries from across the nation.
